## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `defender-for-servers` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Reserved slot — not yet implemented.** `defender-for-servers` is `status: reserved` / `phase: phase-planning` in canon. No adapter code exists yet. The Tier-1 criteria below define the conformance gate the adapter **must** clear at activation; they are a forward-looking plan, not a current result.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: `server-vulnerability-state`, `server-edr-findings`, `posture-recommendations`, `security-baseline-state`

**Validation artifacts:** `defender-servers-findings.json`, `defender-servers-posture.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/defender-for-servers/defender-for-servers.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `RA-5`, `CA-7`, `SI-2`, `SI-4`, `CM-6`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **RA-5** Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning | Primary | Per-server vulnerability inventory is the canonical vulnerability-monitoring evidence source for Arc-enrolled and Azure-VM servers. |
| **CA-7** Continuous Monitoring | Primary | Scheduled telemetry collection provides continuous server posture evidence with the freshness-window semantics defined in canon. |
| **SI-2** Flaw Remediation | Supporting | Vulnerability inventory + posture recommendations drive the server-side patch / update remediation queue (remediation itself is a sibling adapter). |
| **SI-4** System Monitoring | Primary | Server-side EDR findings + active alert inventory provide the canonical server-monitoring evidence. |
| **CM-6** Configuration Settings | Supporting | Microsoft cloud-security-baseline compliance state surfaces deviations from the configured baseline; deviations route to `azure-policy-arc` for remediation. |

## Notes from canon

Reserved slot per ADR-049. Read-only telemetry feed for Arc-server EDR findings, posture recommendations, vulnerability state, and security-baseline state from Microsoft Defender for Servers. Complements the `azure-arc` modernization adapters by providing the server-plane risk signal that UIAO_136 Spec 1 device-cohort sequencing depends on.
